name: A Bathing Ape
why: Ura-Harajuku camouflage and ape-head graphics turned into a global logo house; the shark hood is the piece everything else orbits.
origin: Nigo, Harajuku, 1993 — built on scarcity and camo. Sold to Hong Kong's I.T Group in 2011; Nigo left in 2013.
opview: The house sells scarcity as the product: limited runs, camo as a signature, and a hood that covers the face.

onething.n: verified — direct product page, $569. The full-face zip hood is the brand's whole signature; the BAPE STA sits in the shoe slot rather than competing here

notes.street: one of the founding houses of the register rather than a participant in it
notes.status: logo and camo are the point; the garment is a carrier for both
notes.shoes: the BAPE STA is a core line, not an accessory to the clothing
notes.cotton: heavy cotton fleece and jersey carry almost the whole range

cities: Own shops on Mercer St and Madison Ave, Melrose, Miami Design District, Oak St Chicago, Stockton St San Francisco, Wynn Plaza and American Dream
